## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`), n fast × B 0 → 10 T — the stacking-call dataset

> **05:25** · landau-fan: D=0 line (run-5 cal), n -1.25..+3.25e12 fast 226 pts (0.02e12) co-swept TG/BG; B 0->10 T slow 201 rows (50 mT); Vsi=0, base T; sr1 200 uV, NPLC 1 · **ETA ~15:55** (≈10h30m)

**Plan step 4** (`hera_scratch/plan.md`; operator-requested this move). The spot checks (runs 6–7, ana) show multi-tone SdH on both carrier signs with oscillations resolvable from ≲ 1 T to 10 T — but a frequency inventory alone can't make the stacking call (harmonic ladders and the region-B mosaic at ×1.13 n confound tone counting). The fan's **integer-ν gap sequence and its degeneracy/crossing pattern vs B** is the discriminator between ABAB (two bilayer-like sectors → crossing-rich fan, 4-fold-dominant gaps with sector crossings), ABCA (|k|⁴-like zero-LL multiplet → strong CNP-adjacent structure), and ABCB; it also delivers the **lever-arm check** on the run-5 n-scale (fan-line slopes; the absolute scale is still a geometry prior) and flags mosaic-B lines if the sr1 pair sees both regions. **Design:** fast axis n = −1.25 … +3.25×10¹² (226 pts, 0.02×10¹²) co-sweeping (V_tg, V_bg) along the calibrated D = 0 line — endpoints (−0.291, −0.484) → (+0.998, +1.185) V, inside the validators; slow axis B = 0 → 10 T, 201 rows at 50 mT (magnet starts at 0 T where it sits; ends at 10 T — next step rides down, never re-traverse). ν coverage at 10 T: −5.2 … +13.4. **Coverage trade, stated:** the hole side ends at n = −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) — hole fillings beyond |ν| ≈ 5 at 10 T are simply not reachable inside the committed limits; the call will lean electron-side. n-step 0.02×10¹² resolves 4-fold gap spacing from ~1.5 T and single-ν splitting above ~4 T. **Settings changed in-cell (printed before/after):** Keithley gate-current reads NPLC 10 → 1 (leakage established: runs 0–3 + every run's guard, ~−90 pA median; rig-card timing note names NPLC 10 as the pre-leakage-check default) — this is the difference between ~10.5 h and ~15 h; sr1 sensitivity 200 µV = 20 kΩ FS (0.7 Ω quantization for the low-B oscillations; the ν = 0/CNP ridge may clip above ~20 kΩ at high B — accepted, gap position still reads).
